commands.name: emem:shared_fact (MCP)
commands.description: Turn something you observed into a signed record with one address, so another agent reads the same bytes instead of your summary of them. The core loop: ground it, read it, mint a citation.

commands.name: emem:verify_claim (MCP)
commands.description: Someone handed you a number, a token, or an assertion. Find out whether it resolves, whether the signature holds, and whether anyone signed a different value at the same address, without trusting the party who gave it to you or this responder.

commands.name: emem:carry_state (MCP)
commands.description: Your context is ending, or the work is going to another agent. Collapse what matters into citations that survive the boundary, instead of a summary that loses the ability to be checked.

commands.name: emem:a2a_exchange (MCP)
commands.description: The agent-to-agent door: find peers, read your inbox, send a signed message, hand over a citation another agent resolves and verifies without trusting you. Answers with the concrete call sequence for the exchange you name.

commands.name: emem:flood_history (MCP)
commands.description: Long-term flood/inundation history at a place, classified from JRC Global Surface Water v1.4 (1984–2021).

commands.name: emem:air_quality_now (MCP)
commands.description: Current PM2.5 / PM10 / NO2 / O3 / SO2 / CO at a place, classified against WHO 2021 AQG ladder.

commands.name: emem:urban_heat (MCP)
commands.description: Urban-heat-island assessment from MODIS LST day/night and indices.urban_canopy_index, with cooling-potential note.

commands.name: emem:place_summary (MCP)
commands.description: Quick characterisation: landcover (ESA WorldCover), elevation (Cop-DEM), greenness (NDVI), current temperature.

commands.name: emem:compare_places (MCP)
commands.description: Cosine similarity over the geotessera 128-D embedding, with dominant-band rationale.

commands.name: emem:forest_loss (MCP)
commands.description: Hansen Global Forest Change v1.13 layers: tree cover 2000, year of loss (2001–2025), gain mask.

commands.name: emem:coastal_eutrophication (MCP)
commands.description: SDG 14.1.1a coastal-eutrophication first-pass: floating-algae index + chlorophyll proxy + turbidity + SST.

commands.name: emem:carbon_uptake_anomaly (MCP)
commands.description: GPP anomaly z-score from MOD17A2H trajectory (current 8-day vs same-DOY climatology).
